text: Visiting Warpweavers are ethereals located outside the Caverns of Time during the Bronze Celebration in Tanaris. They are present during the Fashion Frenzy event.
Void-Cursed Crushers are skardyn located in the Stormrider Barracks, Dock Lifts, and Abandoned Mines in the Rookery.

Vision of C'Thun is a projection that appears during Story Time in Tanaris. It appears in The Heroes of the Scarab Wall.
__NOTOC__ Void-Crystal Panther is a jeweled panther mount created with Khaz Algar Jewelcrafting (30). The recipe is learned from Design: Void-Crystal Panther.

Void-Forged Stallion's Reins teach the Void-Forged Stallion, a void-infused horse mount. This item is a guaranteed drop from the Void-Forged Stallion mob that can be summoned in the Dwarven District in the Vision of Stormwind during Horrific Visions Revisited.

Void-Scarred Boarhide is an ingredient for the Boarhide Deathcycle Seat used for the Felreaver Deathcycle during Horrific Visions Revisited. The boarhide is found in Rexxar's chest after clearing the Valley of Honor in the Vision of Orgrimmar with at least one mask active. The seat also requires 5x Weavercloth Spellthread from Khaz Algar tailoring.

Void-Scarred Pack Mother's Harness teaches the Void-Scarred Pack Mother, a void wolf mount. This item is a guaranteed drop from the Void-Scarred Wolf mob that can be summoned in the Drag in the Vision of Orgrimmar during Horrific Visions Revisited.

Vision Tormentor's Cloak is obtained from Horrific Visions Revisited. Explorer gear is obtained by completing a Horrific Vision with 0-4 objectives finished. Adventurer gear is given when a full clear is done with 1-4 masks active, while Veteran gear is rewarded after completion with at least 5 masks active. The cosmetic version is sold by Torie south of the Coreway in Dornogal for 400 Displaced Corrupted Mementos after completing the achievement We Have the Memories.
Void-Scarred Scorpid is a scorpid companion which can be found in Garona's Corrupted Chest at the end of the Vision of Orgrimmar during Horrific Visions Revisited.

The Void-Scarred Egg teaches how to summon the Void-Scarred Tallstrider Chick, a tallstrider companion. The item is occasionally found in Geya'rah's Corrupted Chest at the end of the Vision of Orgrimmar during Horrific Visions Revisited.

in Vision of Orgrimmar]] Void-Forged Inline Four Engine is one of several parts for the Felreaver Deathcycle from Horrific Visions Revisited. Void-Forged Engine Block is found at in Nogg's Machine Shop (the Engineering building) in the Drag of Vision of Orgrimmar with at least one mask active during Horrific Visions Revisited. This is one of the ingredients to make the Void-Forged Inline Four Engine, part of the Felreaver Deathcycle.

The Void-Forged Stallion is a horse that can be summoned in the Vision of Stormwind during Horrific Visions Revisited. Summoning it requires entering the vision with at least one Faceless Mask equipped, finding the four Cursed Horseshoes, and melting them in the Forge in the Dwarven District's blacksmithing area. This must all be done within a single run. It has a 100% chance to drop the Void-Forged Stallion's Reins.

The Void-Scarred Wolf is a wolf that can be summoned in the Vision of Orgrimmar during Horrific Visions Revisited. Summoning it requires entering the vision with at least one Faceless Mask equipped, finding the Bag of Wolf Tack and Worn Wolf Saddle, and then interacting with the Wolf Skin Rug in Kodohide Leatherworkers in the Drag. This must all be done within a single run. It has a 100% chance to drop the Void-Scarred Pack Mother's Harness.

Void-Scarred Cubs are wyverns found atop the Orgrimmar Skyway in the Vision of Orgrimmar during Horrific Visions Revisited. The skyway can only be reached after defeating Vez'okk the Lightless in the Valley of Wisdom while wearing at least two Faceless Masks. Attacking the cubs will begin a wave-based encounter, with a few waves of Void-Scarred Cubs, a few waves of Void-Scarred Wyverns, and finally the Void-Scarred Wyvern Matriarch.

Void-Scarred Wyverns appear as part of an encounter started by attacking the Void-Scarred Cubs atop the Orgrimmar Skyway in the Vision of Orgrimmar during Horrific Visions Revisited. The skyway can only be reached after defeating Vez'okk the Lightless in the Valley of Wisdom while wearing at least two Faceless Masks. The encounter consists of a few waves of Void-Scarred Cubs, a few waves of Void-Scarred Wyverns, and finally the Void-Scarred Wyvern Matriarch.

The Void-Scarred Wyvern Matriarch is a wyvern who appears as part of an encounter started by attacking the Void-Scarred Cubs atop the Orgrimmar Skyway in the Vision of Orgrimmar during Horrific Visions Revisited. The skyway can only be reached after defeating Vez'okk the Lightless in the Valley of Wisdom while wearing at least two Faceless Masks. The encounter consists of a few waves of Void-Scarred Cubs, a few waves of Void-Scarred Wyverns, and finally the Void-Scarred Wyvern Matriarch.

Void-Touched Augment Rune is contained in a Void-Touched Satchel of Cooperation, awarded to players who fulfill role in need queues for random dungeons. Players can also receive them through the Work Order system or as a quest reward from either of the neighborhood weekly quests: Lost Animals or Going Postal.

The Vision of Sire Denathrius appears in the Ember Court after speaking to Theotar during Hallow's End. He will then move around scaring the guests for bonus happiness. He can be told to stop scaring the guests, or be removed altogether by talking again to Theotar. When the Ember Court is finished, he will offer Visions of Sire Denathrius (quest), which will reward Visions of Sire Denathrius to permanently add him to the Ember Court.
